name: Payment
definition: Payment information and processes required to transfer cash end to end from the debtor to the creditor.

CurrencyOfTransfer.name: Currency Of Transfer
CurrencyOfTransfer.definition: Specifies the currency of the amount to be transferred which may be different from the currency of the debtor's account.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type, or nature, of the payment, eg, express payment.

InstructedAmount.name: Instructed Amount
InstructedAmount.definition: Amount of money to be moved between the debtor and creditor, before deduction of charges, expressed in the currency as ordered by the initiating party.

Priority.name: Priority
Priority.definition: Urgency or order of importance that the originator would like the recipient of the payment  to apply to its processing.

ValueDate.name: Value Date
ValueDate.definition: Date on which a payment must be executed

PoolingAdjustmentDate.name: Pooling Adjustment Date
PoolingAdjustmentDate.definition: Date used for the correction of the value date of a cash pool movement that has been posted with a different value date.

EquivalentAmount.name: Equivalent Amount
EquivalentAmount.definition: Amount of money to be transferred between debtor and creditor, before deduction of charges, expressed in the currency of the debtor's account, and to be transferred in a different currency.

InstructionForCreditorAgent.name: Instruction For Creditor Agent
InstructionForCreditorAgent.definition: Further information related to the processing of the payment instruction that may need to be acted upon by the creditor agent. |Usage: The instruction can relate to a level of service, can be an instruction to be executed by the creditor's agent, or can be information required by the creditor's agent to process the instruction.

InstructionForDebtorAgent.name: Instruction For Debtor Agent
InstructionForDebtorAgent.definition: Further information related to the processing of the payment instruction that may need to be acted upon by the debtor's agent.  |Usage: The instruction can relate to a level of service, can be an instruction to be executed by the debtor's agent, or can be information required by the debtor's agent to process the instruction.

PaymentInstrument.name: Payment Instrument
PaymentInstrument.definition: Payment type at the origin of the cash entry eg, a cheque.

PaymentObligation.name: Payment Obligation
PaymentObligation.definition: Specifies the obligation which created the payment.

CreditMethod.name: Credit Method
CreditMethod.definition: Specifies the transfer method to be used for the credit.

PaymentStatus.name: Payment Status
PaymentStatus.definition: Specifies the status of a payment at a specified time.

PartyRole.name: Party Role
PartyRole.definition: Specifies each role linked to a payment and played by a party at that step in a payment flow.

PaymentExecution.name: Payment Execution
PaymentExecution.definition: Describes the processes necessary to execute a payment.

CurrencyExchange.name: Currency Exchange
CurrencyExchange.definition: Information on the exchange rate and amounts used in the payment

PaymentRelatedIdentifications.name: Payment Related Identifications
PaymentRelatedIdentifications.definition: Identifications provided to identify a payment at different processing levels.

RelatedInvestigationCase.name: Related Investigation Case
RelatedInvestigationCase.definition: Investigation case assigned to the payment.

SettlementTimeRequest.name: Settlement Time Request
SettlementTimeRequest.definition: Information on the requested settlement time of the instruction.

TradeSettlement.name: Trade Settlement
TradeSettlement.definition: Specifies the settlement operation which originates the payment.

RelatedDebitAuthorisation.name: Related Debit Authorisation
RelatedDebitAuthorisation.definition: Payment which is the result of the debit authorisation

RelatedInvestigationCaseResolution.name: Related Investigation Case Resolution
RelatedInvestigationCaseResolution.definition: Case resolution related to a specific payment.

ReturnPayment.name: Return Payment
ReturnPayment.definition: Payment which offsets an original payment.

RelatedSecuritiesSettlement.name: Related Securities Settlement
RelatedSecuritiesSettlement.definition: Securities settlement process which is the source of the payment.

InvoiceReconciliation.name: Invoice Reconciliation
InvoiceReconciliation.definition: Reconciliation of the amounts of an invoice with the amounts included in one or more payments.

Adjustments.name: Adjustments
Adjustments.definition: Specifies the charges or the allowance related to a payment.

ContractRegistration.name: Contract Registration
ContractRegistration.definition: Provides the payment of the registered contract.
